title: LbVserver
description: A load balancing virtual server configuration that accepts incoming client traffic and distributes it across bound backend services using a configured load balancing algorithm.

name.description: Name for the load balancing virtual server. Must be unique and begin with a letter, number, or underscore. Maximum 127 characters.

servicetype.description: Protocol of the service running on the virtual server.

ipv46.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to assign to the virtual server. Usually a VIP address on the NetScaler used as the entry point for client traffic.

port.description: Port number on which the virtual server listens.

ipset.description: Name of the IP set to bind to the virtual server. Provides multiple IPs for the virtual server.

range.description: Number of IP addresses that the appliance must generate using the virtual server VIP address and the netmask. Range 2-254.

ippattern.description: IP address pattern for identifying packets to be accepted by the virtual server. Used with ipmask.

ipmask.description: IP address mask with the IP pattern to form an IP address range for the virtual server.

td.description: Traffic domain identifier. Isolates traffic across virtual servers. Range 0-4094.

lbmethod.description: Load balancing method used to select the backend service for each client request.

hashlength.description: Number of bytes to use for the hash value in hash-based load balancing methods. Range 1-4096.

netmask.description: IPv4 subnet mask for hashing in SOURCEIPHASH, DESTINATIONIPHASH, and SRCIPDESTIPHASH methods.

v6netmasklen.description: Number of bits in the IPv6 prefix for hash-based LB methods. Range 1-128.

backuplbmethod.description: Backup load balancing method used when the primary method fails to select a service.

persistencetype.description: Type of persistence for the virtual server. Ensures requests from the same client go to the same service.

persistmask.description: IPv4 netmask for source IP persistence. Applied to the source IP before matching for persistence.

v6persistmasklen.description: IPv6 prefix length for source IP persistence. Range 1-128.

persistencebackup.description: Backup persistence type for the virtual server.

timeout.description: Persistence timeout in minutes. The period for which persistence sessions are maintained. Range 0-1440.

persistavpno.description: AVP numbers to use for Diameter persistence.

cookiename.description: Name of the cookie generated by the NetScaler for cookie insert persistence.

rule.description: Expression or name of a named expression that the virtual server uses to evaluate client requests. Default is true.

listenpolicy.description: Expression identifying traffic accepted by the virtual server. Default is NONE.

listenpriority.description: Priority of the listen policy. Range 0-100.

resrule.description: Expression specifying which response to send when the virtual server matches the client request rule.

push.description: Process traffic with the push virtual server bound to this virtual server.

pushlabel.description: Expression for extracting a label from the request. Used by the push virtual server.

pushmulticlients.description: Allow multiple clients to connect to the push virtual server.

comment.description: Informational description or comments about the virtual server.

clttimeout.description: Client idle timeout in seconds. Time to wait before closing an idle client connection. Range 0-31536000.

somethod.description: Spillover method. Defines the condition under which traffic spills over to the backup virtual server.

sopersistence.description: Whether to maintain persistence when spillover occurs.

sopersistencetimeout.description: Persistence timeout in minutes during spillover. Range 2-1440.

sothreshold.description: Threshold value for the spillover method. Meaning varies based on somethod selected.

healththreshold.description: Minimum percentage of UP services required to consider the virtual server as UP. Range 0-100.

redirecturl.description: URL to which requests are redirected when all services bound to the virtual server are DOWN.

downstateflush.description: Flush all active transactions on all services bound to the virtual server when the state changes to DOWN.

disableprimaryondown.description: When a virtual server goes DOWN, remain the primary virtual server in the HA pair so clients continue to connect.

insertvserveripport.description: Insert the virtual server IP address and port in the request header.

vipheader.description: Name of the HTTP header used to insert the virtual server IP and port.

authenticationhost.description: FQDN of the authentication virtual server to which the user is redirected for authentication.

authentication.description: Whether authentication is enabled for the virtual server.

authn401.description: Whether to use HTTP 401-based authentication instead of redirect-based.

authnvsname.description: Name of the authentication virtual server for 401-based authentication.

icmpvsrresponse.description: How the NetScaler responds to ICMP ping requests sent to the VIP.

rhistate.description: Route health injection state. Whether to advertise the route to the VIP via dynamic routing when the server is UP.

newservicerequest.description: Number of requests to accept on a new service before distributing traffic to all bound services. Range 0-100.

newservicerequestincrementinterval.description: Interval in seconds between successive increments for new service request rate. Range 0-3600.

minautoscalemembers.description: Minimum number of members for autoscale. Range 0-5000.

maxautoscalemembers.description: Maximum number of members for autoscale. Range 0-5000.

skippersistency.description: Controls persistence behavior when selecting a service for certain virtual server types.

appflowlog.description: Whether to log AppFlow records for the virtual server.

state.description: Administrative state of the virtual server.

connfailover.description: Mode of connection failover for the virtual server in HA deployments.

redirurl.description: Redirect URL string configured on the virtual server.

curstate.description: Current operational state of the virtual server.

effectivestate.description: Effective state of the virtual server considering all factors.

status.description: Current status of the virtual server. 1 indicates UP.

lbrrreason.description: Reason for the last load balancing redirection.

totalservices.description: Total number of services bound to the virtual server.

activeservices.description: Number of active (UP) services bound to the virtual server.

statechangetimesec.description: Time when the virtual server state last changed, in date-time format.

tickssincelaststatechange.description: Number of ticks since the last state change.

health.description: Percentage of UP services to total bound services.

isgslb.description: Whether this virtual server is a GSLB virtual server.
